66:1.text: O Prophet, why do you prohibit
what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

66:2.text: Allāh has already ordained for you
And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.

66:3.text: when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed
of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."

66:4.text: , for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are

66:5.text: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you
, would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting
, believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling

66:6.text: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are
angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

66:7.text: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
